purpose: Select exactly one compact, evidence-supported standout insight that maximises curiosity without completing the participant's understanding.

exclusive_responsibility.rule: Section 4 is the only page section permitted to declare the single most interesting, distinctive or surprising overall finding.
exclusive_responsibility.section1: Recognition highlight is corroborating evidence only.

clarification: A rare-combination candidate qualifies only with approved joint-prevalence evidence.
A cross-dimensional relationship may outrank a rare combination when the rarity evidence is weak or the relationship is materially more explainable.
A standalone dimension deviation may be selected only when it exceeds the provisional minimum distinctiveness threshold.
If no candidate clears the required confidence and distinctiveness thresholds, select the balanced-profile fallback.
reason_code_requirement: Every selected finding must include one explicit reason code and traceable supporting evidence.
overlap_rules: Reject an exact claim already displayed in Sections 1–3.
Reject the Section 1 winning recognition claim and supporting highlight as Section 4 outputs.
Reject a Section 2 question-level claim unless Section 4 transforms it into a supported higher-order relationship not previously stated.
Reject a standalone Section 3 dimension unless no higher-tier non-duplicative candidate qualifies.
Shared dimensions are allowed; repeated conclusions are not.
behaviour_context_rule: Explain why the finding depends on multiple behaviours or wider context. Do not mention purchasing, unlocking, pricing or the full report.

curiosity_peak.section4: Curiosity peak: one unresolved, memorable finding.
curiosity_peak.section6: Understanding peak if retained: broader synthesis without repeating the Section 4 claim.

ties: Resolve by priority tier, evidence confidence, non-overlap score, behavioural meaningfulness, then stable finding ID order. If all candidates remain below thresholds, use the balanced-profile fallback.

balanced_profile_fallback.purpose: Preserve honesty when no single finding genuinely stands out.
selection_conditions: No cross-dimensional relationship meets the confidence threshold.
No unrepeated question-level response meets the distinctiveness threshold.
No standalone dimension exceeds the provisional minimum distinctiveness threshold.
balanced_profile_fallback.interpretation: Balance itself becomes the finding; the engine must not invent a standout.
